entity: Las Vegas Sands, Texas lobby media/ad spending, 2021-2026
what_we_add: $20.58M over 62 monthly lobby reports under Andy Abboud, May 2021-Jun 2026; 70-71% of all Texas lobby media, 2.5x all other lobbyists combined; about 4x Sands' federal lobby fees
why: Texas Tribune and Texas Standard name Sands and report a multimillion-dollar, nonstop Texas TV ad campaign: same finding in words. The '$2M+' and '$10-20M' figures cover the 2021 session only, a floor inside our 5-year window, so no contradiction; no source has the lobby-report total or the 2.5x comparison.
